a.lede: Last year, Waymo recalled its software after several of its autonomous cars drove around stopped buses. But the problems remained. Now the feds want to know more.
a.title: Waymo Said It Fixed Its School Bus Problem. The US Government Says It Didn’t Work

b.lede: The electric automaker has apologized and said it will fix the issue for affected vehicles.
b.title: BYD admits wheel assembly error on its flagship electric SUV
